1. Market regime

Context, not part of the signal: VIX level, VIX/VIX3M term structure and credit stress, each as a percentile of its own 5-year history

CalmPanic = VIX term structure inverted (VIX above VIX3M). Elevated = gauge ≥ 70. Calm otherwise.
Breadth: 62% of S&P 500 members below their 50-day, 41% below their 200-day, 2.7% at 52-week lows. VIX / VIX3M = 0.90.

2. Buy Signals

Historic leaders (beat SPY over the 5 years ending ~3 months ago, top 33% of the universe) where weekly RSI ≤ its own 5% percentile, monthly RSI ≤ its own 10% percentile, and 20-day volatility hit its own VIX-35 equivalent (96th percentile of its history) in the last 20 trading days. Listed for 5 trading days after the signal. Crypto (BTC, ETH) uses the same rules on its 7-day calendar, with leader = beat SPY over 5 years.

Columns. RSI values are live (the current week/month closes at today's price); the percentile is where today's value sits in every completed bar of the name's history, and green means it is at or below the signal threshold. Spike level = the name's own VIX-equivalent volatility. Driver = whether the 21-day move is mostly explained by the market, the sector ETF, or the stock alone. Hist. base rate = average 6-month excess return vs SPY and hit rate for this signal in the 2005+ backtest.
